title: Delete or properly @Deprecated the dead, self-documented-buggy toggleStudyDay provider

evidence.quote: ///   1. It does not push sync (no syncFacade call).
// BUG: this fires before the write completes (STUDYDAY-TOGGLE-RACE-14).

why: toggleStudyDayProvider has zero call sites anywhere in lib/ or test/ (confirmed by repo-wide grep) and its own doc comment states it is dead and buggy (no sync push, plus a documented race condition already fixed in study_day_config_screen.dart's _toggleDay). Yet it is not marked `@Deprecated`, so nothing — not the analyzer, not code review tooling — stops a future contributor from wiring it up and reintroducing the documented race, since a doc-comment warning is easy to miss while an `@Deprecated` annotation surfaces as an analyzer diagnostic at the call site.
recommendation: Delete the provider (it has no callers) or, if it must stay for build_runner stability as the comment claims, mark it `@Deprecated('Use study_day_config_screen._toggleDay instead — this has a known race, DNI-####')`.
acceptance_criteria: toggleStudyDay is either removed or carries an @Deprecated annotation with a Linear id.
Confirm via grep that no call sites exist before deleting.

corrections: 'Zero call sites...confirmed by repo-wide grep' is inaccurate: generated_providers_coverage_test.dart:250-259 references toggleStudyDayProvider for toString/==/hash coverage (file header: 'No ProviderContainer needed') — not behavioral execution, but a real reference deletion would break. Acceptance criteria should add updating that test. Also the line-66 evidence quote is actually the text at line 65 (off-by-one citation).
